title: Christian Pentz, Glückstadt 1644-45: the Pentz-family index cipher (key of targets/pentz1636) completed from a contemporary interlinear decipherment; letter of 29 Apr 1644 read, letter of 1645 read in part

documents.shelfmark: Copenhagen, Rigsarkivet, Tyske Kancelli, SHLK A IV 89, Relationer fra guvernør i Glückstadt Christian Pentz 1629-45, unit 274999, images 321 (recto) and 322/323 (verso, two shots of one page)
documents.route: Christian Pentz, governor of Glückstadt -> Christian IV

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment over every cipher figure on the recto (image 321) and over line 1 of the verso (image 322); the rest of the verso has none.

transcription.notes: Recto: figures and glosses in key_history/GLOSES-1644.tsv (one reader, glosses read with the figures). Verso lines 2-11: two passes (A, then B on re-made crops without looking at A), identical, frozen by SHA-256 before any decode. Counts not measured. Length: 89 figure groups on verso lines 2-11 (docs/_check_profile.py --measure --digits --drop-first on the file) + 116 on the recto and verso line 1 (key_history/GLOSES-1644.tsv, counted by us; the 21 at the head of verso line 2 counted once), so measured is false.

plaintext.source: Contemporary marginal decipherment of the cipher of lines 1-9 (another hand, insertion mark); later word glosses over lines 6, 10-12. Both read only after the measurement.

system.summary: Index numbers select the number alphabet for the run that follows (62/64: table 1, a-i = 37..29, k-z = 14..28; 13/11: table 2, a-i = 38..46, n 61 ... u 54; 10/8: table 3, a-i = 29..37 and k-z = 28..14 with g 33, e 35, r 39), a null 251 and three-digit codes; the key of targets/pentz1636 (McBratney) with table 3 completed.
system.sibling_key: targets/pentz1636 (same writer, same key family; tables 1-2 identical)
system.notes: distinct_symbols = letter values in key v3 (24 per table) not signs seen. nomenclator: 301 = Archbishop (of Bremen) from a marginal decipherment; 560 and 756 open.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherment on image 321 (and line 1 of image 322) and a contemporary marginal decipherment on image 425, on the leaves themselves. Modern: targets/pentz1636 (McBratney, PR #522) holds the key family (tables 1-2, index numbers, partial table 3) but not these letters. Printed editions not searched beyond pentz1636's checks.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules (pre-registration frozen before the key and the held-out, two blind transcription passes, one measurement, Daniel Bourdeau's read bar); a Claude session did the transcription, key, measurement, reading and this folder. No reading by a person without AI.
tools: own Python decoder and pre-registered measure (scripts/measure2.py; German 4-gram, repository corpus de-gutenberg)

solution.what: Unit 274999 (503 images) fetched with curl from api.rigsarkivet.dk; thumbnails 137-502 swept: number-cipher pages at images 321-323, 402-405, 408, 411, 412, 420, 425 (1644-45).

Image 321 carries a contemporary letter-by-letter decipherment over every figure: 41 figure-letter pairs; they fit pentz1636 tables 1-2 and index numbers, and give table 3 as a mirror of table 1 with g 33, e 35, r 39; 251 is a null. Pre-registration and measure frozen (21:35 CET), key v3 frozen (21:36).

Held-out (image 322 lines 2-11 + image 425, 286 figures, two identical passes, frozen 21:41) decoded once: coverage 99.6%, N = 0.760 against bar 0.75, best of 200 within-table permutations 0.145 (bar +0.30): PASS. Readings: 1644 letter 27/28, 1645 letter 38/41.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Table 3, the null and the index numbers 10, 8, 11, 64 were fixed from the contemporary interlinear decipherment on image 321; tables 1-2 are pentz1636's (McBratney). The frozen key then read the unglossed verso (image 322) and a second letter (image 425) under a pre-registered test.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Per document, never pooled: 29 Apr 1644 27/28 = 96.4% (verso alone 13/14); 1645 38/41 = 92.7%. fraction_read is the 1644 letter. readings/*.md list the units.

validation.notes: Own pre-registered test (scripts/PREREG-2.md, scripts/measure2.py), not docs/_validate.py: German 4-gram, true -2.338 per char, 200 within-table permutations mean -4.046, best -3.719, German reference -1.797; N 0.760 vs best control 0.145; PASS (bar 0.75 and +0.30).

texts.label: Christian Pentz to Christian IV, Glückstadt, 29 Apr 1644
texts.summary: Pentz tells the King he can no longer harass the Swedes from Glückstadt as his raiding parties did, because the garrison was cut and the troops sent to Dithmarschen; at times only four men hold the ravelin before the Krempe gate, and the troops in Dithmarschen have done nothing against the enemy.

reading_review.by: Claude (Anthropic), for Brice Dudout: a model reading, not a person, and not independent (same session).
reading_review.note: Every cipher word sits in its clear clause; recto glossed by the contemporary decipherer and matched by the key; verso read by the frozen key alone, one word probable.

texts.label: Christian Pentz to the Chancellor, 1645
texts.summary: With the Archbishop of Bremen's consent Pentz sent a strong party to fall on Wrangel's quarters; the men could move hidden in the wood by a separate road as far as Rendsburg.

reading_review.by: Claude (Anthropic), for Brice Dudout: a model reading, not a person, and not independent (same session).
reading_review.note: Running German read by the frozen key alone, confirmed after the measure by a contemporary marginal decipherment; two codes and one four-figure group open.

outcome.notes: Figures per document, not pooled. Same key as targets/pentz1636; could be merged there as key v3 and documents 3-4.
